channel.title: somewhere.ph
channel.description: Practical Philippines travel guides: islands, beaches, itineraries, ferries, weather and costs, written for first-time and returning visitors.

item.title: Traveling to the Philippines for the first time
item.description: Entry rules, money, SIM cards, getting around and the mistakes first-time visitors make in the Philippines.

item.title: A first-timer's guide to Filipino food, from adobo to halo-halo
item.description: The Filipino dishes to try first, where to eat them, how to order at a carinderia, what to eat at Christmas and the history behind the flavors.

item.title: Batanes: stone houses, rolling hills and the edge of the Philippines
item.description: How to get to Batanes, what to see on Batan and Sabtang islands, when to go around typhoon season, and what makes Ivatan life so special.

item.title: Boracay travel guide: White Beach, sunsets and the island's second chance
item.description: How to get to Boracay, which station to stay in, the best beaches and sunset sails, island rules since the 2018 closure, and the best season to go.

item.title: Siquijor: waterfalls, old churches and the island of fireflies
item.description: How to get to Siquijor, how to explore the island by scooter, the best beaches and waterfalls, and the real story behind its mystical reputation.

item.title: Banaue and Batad rice terraces: how to visit the Ifugao stairways to the sky
item.description: How to get to Banaue and Batad, the best viewpoints and hikes, when the terraces are green or golden, and how to visit respectfully.

item.title: Vigan, Ilocos Sur: a weekend in the Philippines' Spanish-era town
item.description: How to get to Vigan, what to see on Calle Crisologo, what to eat, and when to go to the best-preserved Spanish colonial town in the Philippines.

item.title: Intramuros: a walk through Manila's old walled city
item.description: How to spend a day in Intramuros, Manila's Spanish-era walled city: Fort Santiago, San Agustín Church, kalesa rides and nearby Binondo.

item.title: Siargao travel guide: surf, lagoons and island life
item.description: When to go to Siargao, where to stay, the best day trips and how to get there.

item.title: Cebu and Bohol: waterfalls, sardines and the Chocolate Hills
item.description: A practical plan for Cebu's south coast and the island of Bohol, including ferries and ethical wildlife tips.

item.title: Two weeks in the Philippines: three itineraries that work
item.description: Realistic two-week Philippines routes for beaches, surf or a first-timer's mix, with flight connections.

item.title: El Nido and Coron, Palawan: how to plan the trip
item.description: How to get to El Nido and Coron, which island-hopping tours to book, and how to travel between them.
